# Hype factor is ready
SpaceX IPO hype drives sectors
I'll pull confirmed calendars and primary sources first so the scan uses exact dates rather than vague “this week” language.*1. Overall Market Condition (Next 1–2 Weeks)*
* Base Environment: Cautious
* Dominant Macro Drivers: SpaceX (SPCX) begins Nasdaq trading on June 12, 2026 after pricing at $135 and opening near $150 in the largest IPO on record; the FOMC meeting on June 16–17, 2026 (decision and SEP/dot plot at 2:00 PM ET on June 17, 2026) is the policy hinge; Advance Monthly Retail Sales for May 2026 print on June 17, 2026; Q1 2026 GDP third estimate and May 2026 Personal Income and Outlays/PCE print on June 25, 2026. May 2026 CPI already released on June 10, 2026 and May 2026 PPI on June 11, 2026, so inflation risk is known but not yet digested through the June 17, 2026 FOMC.
* Key Risks: A hawkish hold or tighter dots at the June 16–17, 2026 FOMC if May 2026 CPI/PPI residuals look sticky; post-IPO volatility and lockup/liquidit ...
